macros.name: MainFile
macros.doc: \MainFile Usually the TeX primitive \jobname contains the name of the “main” TeX file, without the filename extension ‘.tex’. Accordingly, \MainFile is defined as \jobname.tex.

macros.name: SRCOKtrue
macros.doc: You can use these commands to activate/deactivate source specials at any place in your document, e.g. when you experience problems with some special constructions (see also ‘Bugs and Restrictions’ in section 3).
